review_scope: static read-only review of current worktree DOCX section-layout retention/reuse implementation; no build, test, capture, or source edit performed

review_basis.git_diff_check: clean for five reviewed source/test files

evidence: Publication captures source version, reads the current main XML, computes the complete SourceArtifact fingerprint, then reuses only when current XML bytes and Limits are exactly equal.
The post-read source-version fence and existing Commit/Patch byte, lineage, revision, artifact-fingerprint, and Limits authorization run before the writer receives output.

Inventory accounting covers descriptor arrays, column Vec capacities, header/footer slices and relationship String capacities, source-span binding arrays and nested Vec capacities, Arc headers, and tolerance report/vector/location payloads.

Changed commits retain the source base only when checked weight is nonzero and within the caller cap; zero cap, overflow, over-cap, detached source, or explicit release use the existing parse path. No-op commits retain the projected snapshot and reuse it after normal authorization.
The formal correction defines baseline_p50/candidate_p50, with values greater than one meaning candidate speedup, and remains prospective pending a fresh formal cohort.

conditional_documentation_fix.issue: Snapshot::retained_bytes adds size_of::<Snapshot>(), while Commit always contains the inline Option<Snapshot> field even when no base is retained. The Commit docs say the fixed inline Option field is outside the estimate while also saying the snapshot owner is included.
conditional_documentation_fix.required_resolution: Either remove the inline owner size from the incremental retained-weight value, or state explicitly that this is a logical total including the already-present owner and revise the fixed-field sentence. Keep the cap/release behavior unchanged.
conditional_documentation_fix.code_impact: No semantic, authorization, or output correctness issue; the wording-only clarification is accepted.
conditional_documentation_fix.resolution: The current layout.rs wording now identifies the Snapshot owner as a logical charge and separately excludes the always-present inline Option slot from the conditional retention estimate.
